answer: A practical sybil defense is to make every agent identity inherit the reputation and stake of a previously vouched-for parent, so separate identities cannot be spun up for free. At each dawn a scoring round recomputes trust from hardware attestation plus the cost of that lineage, and when an agent acts as a beacon for newcomers it posts a slashable deposit. A fake cluster of walnut-shell accounts earns almost nothing, while splintering a real identity means cloning deposit and compute per node, so an attacker farming a thousand sybils pays a thousand times the honest cost of one.
